# Planck physics engine

`planck.mjs` is the unmodified ESM distribution from Planck 1.5.1 (MIT).

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/planck
- Source: https://github.com/piqnt/planck.js
- Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/planck/-/planck-1.5.1.tgz
- Archive SHA-512 integrity: `x3nHPSyoNTAxN0v8UXrSwP0XVTG0e7JCENBVZljZ8PZOjbOo7aRHq2+fy+DOREDhfW52aq5GiwgIm+m8kIErKQ==`

The archive integrity was checked before copying the distribution. License text is retained in `PLANCK-LICENSE.txt`. Vendoring avoids a runtime dependency on an external CDN. No package installation or bundler is required.
